dependencies.purpose: Expose the bounded passive native-source supervisor to the dedicated Electron security utility through Node-API. Also supplies the separate privileged identity key-custody adapter, with no private-key export API.
dependencies.networkBehavior: None at runtime; Node-API calls remain process-local.
dependencies.nativeBehavior: Links the platform Node-API symbols and uses its reviewed registration build support; it does not bundle a helper executable.
dependencies.transitiveRisk: Adds napi-sys, registration support, futures primitives, serde conversion, and dynamic-symbol loading; exact transitive versions are locked and license checked.
dependencies.localAlternative: Handwritten raw Node-API FFI would require a larger unsafe ABI surface and duplicate value-conversion and environment-lifecycle handling.

dependencies.purpose: Generate the narrow exported Node-API registration shims for the native baseline bridge. Also supplies the separate privileged identity key-custody adapter, with no private-key export API.
dependencies.networkBehavior: None at runtime or build time after Cargo acquisition.
dependencies.nativeBehavior: A compile-time procedural macro emits Node-API registration glue; it ships no standalone binary.
dependencies.transitiveRisk: Adds exact locked syntax and case-conversion macro dependencies used only while compiling the bridge.
dependencies.localAlternative: Maintaining equivalent registration code manually would expand unsafe FFI and make exported ABI review harder.

dependencies.purpose: Serialize and deserialize the generated bounded native DTOs at the Node-API boundary.
dependencies.nativeBehavior: Pure Rust serialization traits and derive macros; no native library or helper process.
dependencies.transitiveRisk: Adds the exact locked serde core and derive macro graph; generated DTO validation still runs independently after conversion.
dependencies.localAlternative: A handwritten serializer for every generated protocol field would duplicate the schema generator and increase wire-shape drift risk.

dependencies.purpose: Encode and decode the fixed, size-prefixed private protocol between the security utility and the packaged native security helper.
dependencies.networkBehavior: None; all frames use private inherited process handles and are validated before nested allocation.
dependencies.nativeBehavior: Pure Rust JSON encoding and decoding; ships no native library, helper, or lifecycle script.
dependencies.transitiveRisk: Uses the exact locked itoa, memchr, serde_core, and zmij graph; fixed frame limits and generated protocol validation remain independent controls.
dependencies.localAlternative: A handwritten JSON implementation would duplicate a security-sensitive parser and make generated cross-language protocol conformance harder to audit.

dependencies.purpose: Apply the standard HMAC construction to the opaque Attempt collection context and raw removable-device identity before any pseudonym crosses the source boundary.
dependencies.nativeBehavior: Pure Rust message-authentication construction; it ships no native library, helper, or lifecycle script.
dependencies.transitiveRisk: Reuses the exact locked digest graph admitted for SHA-256 and activates the exact locked constant-time subtle primitive; neither adds runtime I/O or platform integration.
dependencies.localAlternative: A hand-rolled keyed-hash construction would enlarge the security-sensitive surface and duplicate a standard primitive.

dependencies.purpose: Supply SHA-256 to the standard HMAC derivation for Attempt-keyed, content-free removable-device pseudonyms.
dependencies.nativeBehavior: Pure Rust SHA-256 primitives; it ships no native library, helper, or lifecycle script.
dependencies.transitiveRisk: Adds the exact locked digest, block-buffer, crypto-common, generic-array and typenum graph; the use is local HMAC derivation over bounded inputs.
dependencies.localAlternative: A repository-local cryptographic hash implementation would create a larger security-sensitive surface with no product-specific value.

dependencies.purpose: Typed Windows bindings for display, capture, snapshot process/session inventory, clipboard counters, print queues, mounted removable storage, network topology and proxy state, media-endpoint presence, and packaged helper image/signature verification.
dependencies.networkBehavior: None; the crate provides generated Win32 bindings and links system libraries only.
dependencies.nativeBehavior: No bundled native binary or build script; generated declarations call reviewed Windows display/session, Toolhelp, clipboard, spooler, storage, IP Helper, WinHTTP, SetupAPI, media-class, BCrypt, live-process-image, and Authenticode trust APIs through system linking.
dependencies.transitiveRisk: Locks windows-link 0.2.1, which supplies Windows import linkage without lifecycle scripts or network behavior; it is target-scoped with windows-sys.
dependencies.localAlternative: Handwritten bindings for these ABI-sensitive Windows structures, handles, buffers, and lifecycle functions would enlarge the unsafe surface and increase memory-safety risk.
